title: Vimeo Pricing: Plans, Monthly vs Annual Cost (2026)
summary: Vimeo pricing plans range from free to Enterprise, with details on video storage limits, maximum upload size, and what features come with each tier.
body_markdown:
## Track Vimeo usage against plan limits with Activepieces


If you stay on Vimeo, a scheduled Activepieces workflow can read your usage and message you before a limit forces an upgrade you didn't budget for.


Activepieces lets you chain steps (triggers, API calls, code, notifications) in a visual editor, with unlimited flows on every plan, including free.


Its core is MIT-licensed, and the 746 integrations it ships with are counted straight from the public community directory in its GitHub monorepo, which has 25,329 stars. It reads your numbers and tells you; it doesn't change what Vimeo charges.


Four steps build it, and they show how little there's to maintain: one trigger, one read, one calculation, one message.


1. A weekly Schedule trigger starts the flow.
2. A Vimeo step or API call reads storage used and the quota.
3. A Code step computes percent of limit.
4. A Slack or email alert fires above 80%, which means you have time to respond before storage becomes critical.


Warn at 80% rather than 100% and you have time to trim old videos or compare plans while the choice is still yours, instead of after an upload fails.


### Schedule a weekly Vimeo usage check trigger


Add the Schedule integration and set it to run weekly, on a day when someone'll actually read the result. A Monday morning run puts the message at the start of the week, before anyone uploads a batch.


Weekly is enough for storage, which grows in steps, not by the minute. If your team publishes in bursts around launches, shorten the interval for that period.


### Stage 2: fetch usage from Vimeo


If your Activepieces version lists no Vimeo integration with a usage action, you don't wait on a vendor release: generate the connector with AI and add it privately to your own instance.


Roughly 60% of the catalogue was written by contributors outside the company, so gaps get filled by the people who need them. The quicker route is an HTTP step calling the Vimeo API's` /me` endpoint with an access token from your Vimeo developer settings.


The response includes an` upload_quota` object, and under it` space` holds the used and maximum values. Those two fields're what you need.


Check the response in the step's test output before you wire anything to it, because your account type determines which values come back populated. A blank field here would make every later calculation quietly wrong.


### Send a Vimeo usage limit alert


Add a Code step that divides used by maximum and returns a percentage. Follow it with a Branch step that continues only when the result passes your threshold. On the true path, add a Slack message or an email step.


Put the percentage, the used amount and the quota in the message text, so whoever reads it can decide without opening Vimeo. Name the plan in the message too, so the alert points straight back to the comparison you already made.


Nothing in the workflow changes the bill. The limits and the upgrade price stay exactly as Vimeo sets them.
